verdict.rationale: Sift's docs confirm it offers Review Queues alongside Workflows, and claim manual review time can drop by up to 80%. The founder says most customers have a human review each flagged user before a final go/no-go decision. Supporting context exists in the underlying data: per-event risk scores from 0 to 100 and user lifecycle events sent via the REST API. Missing for 10: any documentation that the queue shows customer history and signals in the review view, any 'similar cases' capability, evidence of features for consistent decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the review queue experience.
